scope: VELDO-0153 review corrections; retired entries are not active registrations or kills

retired.name: effects-completion-first-destination
retired.reason: One checked destination makes first-only completion equivalent to the live implementation; the previous outcomes[1:] replacement duplicated exit-status-only completion.

retired.name: effects-old-tip-checked-at-first-destination
retired.reason: One checked destination makes first-only validation equivalent to production; before[:0] duplicated removal of the old-tip check.

retired.name: effects-push-timeout-not-scaled
retired.reason: AC3 permits one URL, so per-destination scaling has no observable behavior. The flat one-second mutant is registered under its actual defect.

retired.name: effects-header-unchecked
retired.reason: Production no longer parses remote-show headers; reading remote.origin.url was an unrelated invented defect.

retired.name: effects-fetch-line-unchecked
retired.reason: Production no longer parses remote-show fetch lines; reading remote.origin.url was an unrelated invented defect.

retired.name: effects-resolution-locale-not-forced
retired.reason: Production reads untranslated config values and has no locale forcing to remove. The stderr replacement invented a locale dependency.

retired.name: effects-resolution-messages-locale-only
retired.reason: Production has no locale forcing to weaken to LC_MESSAGES. The stderr replacement invented a locale dependency.

retired.name: effects-head-line-unchecked
retired.reason: Production no longer parses a HEAD report line. Omitting the local-config guard is now registered with its actual name.

retired.name: effects-state-read-at-authorized-url
retired.reason: AC3 makes authorized and actual destinations identical. Reading local state is registered as a separate, accurately named defect.

retired.name: effects-push-skips-hooks
retired.reason: The mutant enables hooks, and is byte-identical to identity153-pre-push-hook. Keep one registration for this defect.

retired.name: effects-destination-listing-unchecked
retired.reason: The whole URL-named-section guard removal is byte-identical to identity153-url-section. Keep one registration for this defect.

retired.name: effects-destination-listing-first-only
retired.reason: The live defect exempts pushurl entries from the URL-named-section guard; it no longer checks a first destination.

retired.name: effects-show-exit-unchecked
retired.reason: Resolution uses config --get-all, not a remote-show report.

retired.name: effects-destinations-from-dry-run-output
retired.reason: The defect trusts actual push output, not a removed dry-run.

retired_rows.name: publication-resolution-in-c-locale
retired_rows.reason: No locale forcing remains in production. Config values have no translated grammar; remove the obsolete locale claim and its contrived falsifiers.

retained.name: effects-unlisted-destination-pushed
retained.reason: Failed listing still forbids publication. Routing and configuration-selection rows do not reach the old-tip guard and cannot falsify it.

retained.name: effects-transport-isolated-profile
retained.reason: Exercise real receive with a process-boundary spy. Missing identity profile is asserted before any fixture URL needs translation; the hermetic fence remains unchanged.

retained.name: effects-completion-from-exit-status
retained.reason: The AC3 fan-out fixture refuses before completion is computed. Its refusal remains tested and is falsified by identity153-url-section; only the actual completion row belongs on this mutant.

new_falsifiers.name: effects-remote-host-unchecked
new_falsifiers.guarantee: Remote config values must identify the allowed host, independent of the retired remote-show grammar.
